title: Revert line
description: One row of a revert, as basalt_meta.preview_revert or prepare_revert writes it, in the text rules of CONTRACT.md, Stores, Text rules. RESTORE lines are written; SKIP lines are left as they are and named. Lines are ordered bytewise (COLLATE "C"). See CONTRACT.md, Revert.

op.description: The inverse write the revert runs: DELETE undoes an INSERT, INSERT re-inserts a deleted row, UPDATE restores old values.

shape.description: The kind of data the values describe (CONTRACT.md, Stores, Shapes). RECORD: fields and values. OBJECT is reserved: a page refuses to offer signing for it, and for a shape it does not know.

code.description: The store's error code for a line it could not restore (CONSTRAINT; in Postgres the SQLSTATE the trial write raised, 5 characters); null otherwise.

kind.description: The store's kind (CONTRACT.md, Stores). A page uses it as a label only.

verb.description: The store's own word for this line's own op, the inverse write (CONTRACT.md, Stores, Operations): in Postgres INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE.

key.description: The identity fields the inverse write targets (the primary key in Postgres): the row's current key, or the key it is re-inserted with.

now.description: The full row as it is now; null when it does not exist.

set.description: The values the revert writes (the row before the first in-scope change, generated columns left out); null for DELETE.

resource.description: What the row belongs to, in the store's form: schema.table in Postgres. Untrusted plain text on a page.

conflict.description: Why the row is skipped; null for RESTORE. See CONTRACT.md, Revert, Conflicts.

cascaded.description: The first in-scope change reached this row through an FK cascade.

changeIds.description: The in-scope changes that touched this row, in ledger order.
